annotations.title: Get global activity data (shipping, ports, air, road)

description: FinzData Global Macro Pulse: real-world activity that leads the official statistics. dataset: chokepoints (daily ship transits through Suez, Panama, Hormuz, Malacca and 24 more since 2019), ports (daily port calls and estimated imports/exports for 2,000+ ports since 2019), port_calls (arrivals and hours in port from live ship tracking), air (daily flights by airport, airline, country, region), air_europe, air_us (US flights, cancellations and delays since 1987), road (toll and congestion-zone traffic: New York, Buenos Aires, Hong Kong, Stockholm, Gothenburg, Taiwan). match filters by name or id (e.g. Suez, Singapore, JFK); dim picks airport|airline|country|region for air data. Taiwan and Korea chip exports are macro series (get_macro_vintage).

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

dim.description: For air/air_us: airport, airline, country or region.

match.description: Name or id filter, e.g. Suez Canal, Singapore, JFK, US.

name: get_global_pulse
